modules.module_title: • Prepare for PNG connection installation, repair or maintenance at site

pcs.pc_description: To be in proper dress, PPEs and with valid ID along with double body harness during job site
obtain customer details form supervisor for PNG connection
contact customer for installation, repair or maintenance of PNG connection
obtain clearance, route, isometric graph from Third Party Inspection Engineer (TPIE)/Supervisor for installation of PNG connection
Obtain work permit from concerned officer/Control room
collect drawing, material, measuring instruments, PPE kit, tools and equipment
check the readiness and calibration for error-free functioning of tools and instruments
install maintenance and installation signages at the site
report maintenance and installation activity to the concern
Isolate the Gas supply to PNG connection before start of any maintenance activity

pcs.pc_description: Check equipment i.e. proper dia NPT dye, Lubricant, pipe vice, pipe cutter, Teflon tapes Hammer, drill machine, welding set (for welding if required) etc
Check pipes for straightness, fittings, clamps, meter/meter clamp, regulator, SS screw etc.
measure and mark on the GI pipe for cutting as per the requirement/ isometric using calibrated tools and equipment
cut the GI pipe using hand or power tools
create threads on GI Pipes using threading tools
join the GI pipe with the GI pipe connected to medium density polyethylene pipe
use teflon tape to join the two pipes / fittings
install the GI pipe on wall using clamps as per the blueprint
install isolation valve and appliance valve on GI pipe
install Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) casing on GI pipe in case of underground installation in the wall and electrical cable
install the GI pipe up to the gas meter / appliance valve for connection
In case of multi connection, use RIV after Tee.
Install meter (preferably outside of kitchen) with meter clamps at a maximum height of 4.5 feet so that woman/man can approach IV.
Install AV (ensure distance between stove and AV should be max 1 m) and install rubber hose and tighten rubber hose with hose clamps at both end.
Testing with riser gauge of 4.2 Kg/cm2 of GI installation before meter and after meter section at pressure specified by TPI.
follow safety norms in case of installation of GI pipes on high-rise building such as wear PPE kit/ full safety harness, connect rope safely, etc.
Restore holes/drills with white cement
Complete painting before NGC/Gas charging
In case of NG, testing may be done through mono gauge for part after meter.
call Third Party Inspector Engineer (TPIE) appointed by CGD entity for final inspection
obtain Ready for Conversion (RFC) card singed by engineer
Remove excess pipe material, dirt etc before leaving site
clean the work area after completion of work
report Installation, repair or maintenance activity to the supervisor
carrying out visual and dimensional inspection
check leakage in the pipe by flowing air pressure in GI pipes
use pressure gauge to measure the air pressure on the installed pipes
use leak detectors/ soap solution to identify the leakages in pipeline
repair the identified leakage area
call Third Party Inspector Engineer (TPIE) appointed by CGD entity for final inspection
obtain Ready for Conversion (RFC) card singed by engineer and customer
Resume the Gas supply to customer and appraise the customer for Dos & Don’ts
report supervisor for the completion of testing and inspection activity
